scope: official299 isolated function pipeline; no production code/service/daily data

claims.claim: Official catalog and cache restore are projections, not byte replay; exact observed differences can be recorded using synthetic originals and full after capture.
Catalog/cache/audit/Grok backup are observable transaction changes at fixed paths and can be handled by an operation-bound before/ready/pre-stop/post-stop write-set without broad cleanup.
Full failed postimage capture must serialize changed bytes too; observed differences cannot be inferred only from hashes.

Guarded multi-file compensation must preflight the entire batch and refuse external change/unknown/link/hardlink/ownership gaps without partial overwrite; sync error must roll back to sealed postimage.
